details: Promoting the candidate as a sidecar would duplicate about 43.76 GB across 47 routed layers.

Replacing the resident layout requires a separately correct and non-regressive implementation of the production prefill D8 MMQ128x32 wave-column/raw-prefetch consumer plus paired materialization/cache ownership.
The current experiment therefore does not authorize a runtime/default change.
